name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
description: Stabilized 15% vitamin C serum that visibly evens skin tone, fades dark spots, and protects against environmental stressors. Lightweight texture absorbs in seconds, layers well under SPF.
full_description: Formulated with L-ascorbic acid stabilized at pH 3.5 alongside ferulic acid and vitamin E for a synergistic antioxidant boost. Gentle enough for daily morning use, bottled in dark glass to preserve potency. Visible results on tone and luminosity within four weeks of consistent use. Dermatologist-tested, vegan, and free of parabens, sulfates, and synthetic fragrance. 30 ml.

name: Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
description: Daily hydrating cream powered by triple-weight hyaluronic acid. Plumps fine lines, restores moisture barrier, and leaves a soft dewy finish without any greasy residue.
full_description: Three molecular weights of hyaluronic acid hydrate at the surface, mid-layer, and deep skin level for all-day plumpness. Reinforced with niacinamide 4% to soothe redness and squalane to lock in moisture. Suitable for normal to dry skin, layers seamlessly under makeup. 50 ml in recyclable glass jar.

name: Rosehip Facial Oil
description: Cold-pressed organic rosehip oil rich in vitamin A and essential fatty acids. Regenerates dull skin, softens scars, and adds a healthy glow when used at night.
full_description: Single-ingredient pure rosehip seed oil sourced from sustainable farms in Chile. The cold-pressing process preserves trans-retinoic acid precursors, omega-3 and omega-6, ideal for skin regeneration and elasticity. Apply 3-4 drops to clean skin before night cream. Certified organic by Ecocert. 30 ml dropper bottle.

name: Charcoal Detox Face Mask
description: Activated charcoal clay mask that draws out impurities, refines pores, and leaves skin matte and balanced. Best for oily and combination skin types.
full_description: Combines bamboo charcoal, kaolin clay, and bentonite to absorb excess sebum and unclog pores. A touch of tea tree oil calms blemishes, while glycerin prevents over-drying. Apply once or twice a week for ten minutes, rinse with warm water. 100 ml glass jar.

name: Lavender Body Lotion
description: Calming lavender body lotion with shea butter and oat extract. Hydrates 24 hours, melts in fast, and leaves a delicate scent perfect for evening rituals.
full_description: A soothing daily body lotion built around French lavender essential oil, fair-trade shea butter, and colloidal oatmeal. The formula is rich without feeling heavy and absorbs in under a minute. Pump dispenser, 250 ml. Dermatologically tested, suitable for sensitive skin, vegan and cruelty-free.

name: Matte Lipstick — Berry Red
description: Long-wear matte lipstick in a deep berry red. Velvet finish, eight-hour wear, and a creamy formula that doesn't dry out the lips.
full_description: Pigment-rich matte color delivered in a single swipe. Infused with vitamin E and jojoba oil so the matte finish stays soft, never crackly. The bullet shape contours easily for precise application. Cruelty-free, paraben-free, made in Italy. 3.5 g.

name: Volumizing Mascara
description: Buildable volumizing mascara that lifts, separates, and thickens lashes without flaking or smudging. Hourglass-shaped brush reaches every lash.
full_description: Carnauba and beeswax build smooth volume layer after layer, while pro-vitamin B5 conditions lashes to prevent breakage. Smudge-resistant up to 12 hours, removes easily with warm water. Ophthalmologically tested, safe for contact-lens wearers. 9 ml.

name: Hydrating Sheet Mask Set
description: Pack of five biodegradable cotton sheet masks soaked in hyaluronic acid, green tea, and aloe vera essence. Instant calm, hydration, and glow.
full_description: Each ultra-thin sheet conforms perfectly to the face and delivers a 20-minute spa-quality treatment. Three formulas in the pack: hydrating (HA), brightening (vitamin C), and calming (centella asiatica). Made in South Korea, biodegradable cellulose sheet. 25 ml essence per mask.

name: Natural Lip Balm Trio
description: Set of three nourishing lip balms in honey, vanilla, and pomegranate. Beeswax base with shea butter and vitamin E heals dry lips without stickiness.
full_description: Hand-poured in small batches, this trio uses food-grade ingredients you'd recognize. Beeswax forms a protective barrier, shea butter and sweet almond oil deeply nourish, and natural extracts give gentle color and flavor. Plastic-free cardboard tubes. 4 g each.

name: Argan Hair Repair Oil
description: Pure Moroccan argan oil that tames frizz, restores shine, and protects hair from heat damage. A few drops on damp ends transform any blow-dry.
full_description: Cold-pressed by Berber women's cooperatives in Morocco. 100% argan, no fillers or silicones. Rich in omega-9, vitamin E, and squalene to repair split ends and seal the cuticle. Use as a leave-in on damp hair, an overnight mask on dry ends, or a heat protectant before styling. 50 ml glass dropper.

name: Floral Eau de Parfum
description: Sophisticated floral eau de parfum with notes of rose, jasmine, and white musk. Long-lasting and elegant, appropriate for both daytime and evening wear.
full_description: Top notes of bergamot and pink pepper open into a heart of damask rose and Egyptian jasmine, settling on a base of white musk, sandalwood, and amber. 18% perfume oil concentration ensures 6-8 hours of wear. Refillable bottle, made in France. 50 ml.

name: Retinol Eye Cream
description: Encapsulated retinol eye cream that targets fine lines and crow's feet. Gentle enough for nightly use, with peptides and caffeine to depuff and firm.
full_description: 0.3% encapsulated retinol releases gradually for high efficacy with minimal irritation. Combined with caffeine to reduce puffiness, peptides to firm the under-eye area, and squalane to maintain moisture. Use a pea-sized amount nightly under your moisturizer. Always pair with SPF in the morning. 15 ml airless pump.

name: Coffee Body Scrub
description: Energizing coffee body scrub with brown sugar, coconut oil, and cinnamon. Exfoliates dull skin, smooths texture, and leaves a delicious cocoa-coffee scent.
full_description: Made with upcycled coffee grounds from specialty roasters, brown sugar, raw coconut oil, and a touch of cinnamon and vanilla. Caffeine helps reduce the appearance of cellulite, while sugar and coffee grit provide a satisfying physical exfoliation. Use 2-3 times a week in the shower. 200 g recyclable jar.

name: Mineral Foundation
description: Buildable mineral foundation in a satin finish. Provides medium coverage, evens skin tone, and lets skin breathe without clogging pores. 12 inclusive shades.
full_description: Loose mineral powder pressed into a sleek compact. The formula is talc-free, fragrance-free, and reef-safe — built around mica, zinc oxide, and titanium dioxide. Buildable from sheer to medium-full coverage with a soft satin finish. Twelve shades from porcelain to deep ebony, with neutral, warm, and cool undertones. 9 g.

name: Pastel Nail Polish Set
description: Set of four pastel nail polishes in mint, blush, lavender, and butter yellow. 10-free formula, glossy finish, and a wide brush for fast even application.
full_description: A curated quartet of soft pastels for a fresh seasonal manicure. The formula is 10-free (no toluene, formaldehyde, DBP, camphor, etc.), vegan, and cruelty-free. Each bottle delivers two-coat coverage and a chip-resistant glossy finish that lasts up to a week. 4 × 12 ml.

name: The Art of Mindfulness
description: A practical guide to building a sustainable mindfulness practice. Combines neuroscience, meditation history, and 30 evidence-based exercises for everyday life.
full_description: Written by a clinical psychologist with 20 years of teaching experience, this 240-page guide demystifies mindfulness without losing its depth. Each chapter ends with a guided exercise (audio companion via QR codes) and a journaling prompt. Suitable for total beginners and intermediate practitioners alike. Hardcover, 240 pages.

name: Mediterranean Cookbook
description: 120 seasonal recipes from across the Mediterranean, photographed in natural light. From Sicilian pasta to Lebanese mezze, every dish is approachable for the home cook.
full_description: A modern celebration of Mediterranean cooking, organized by season rather than by country. Each recipe includes prep time, ingredient swaps, and notes from local home cooks who shared their family recipes. Generous full-page photography on every spread. Linen-bound hardcover, 320 pages, ribbon bookmark.

name: Modern Architecture Photography
description: Large-format coffee-table book featuring 200 striking photographs of contemporary architecture from 35 countries. Curated and annotated by award-winning critic L. Marin.
full_description: From Tadao Ando's concrete temples to Bjarke Ingels' playful urbanism, this oversized volume documents the most influential buildings of the past decade. Each photograph is paired with a short essay placing the work in context. 11×14 inches, hardcover with debossed cloth, 312 pages.

name: The Science of Sleep
description: Why we sleep, what happens when we don't, and how to fix it. A research-backed deep dive in plain English, with an actionable plan for better rest.
full_description: Drawing on more than 1,000 peer-reviewed studies, this book explains the role of REM and deep sleep, the impact of light, caffeine, and screens, and how to design a personal sleep protocol. Includes a 30-day improvement plan and an appendix of common sleep disorders. Paperback, 288 pages.

name: Renaissance Painters Anthology
description: Comprehensive anthology of 50 Renaissance masters, from Giotto to Caravaggio. High-resolution reproductions, biographical essays, and analyses of key works.
full_description: A definitive volume for art lovers and students. Each painter is introduced with a 4-6 page essay covering historical context, technique, and major commissions, followed by 8-12 reproductions of key works printed on high-quality semi-gloss paper. Detailed timeline and glossary at the back. Hardcover, 480 pages, 8.5×11 inches.

name: Sustainable Living Guide
description: A no-nonsense, room-by-room guide to lowering your environmental footprint without going off-grid. Practical swaps, realistic budgets, and honest trade-offs.
full_description: Forget perfection — this book focuses on the 20% of changes that drive 80% of impact. Chapters cover the kitchen, bathroom, wardrobe, energy, transport, and finance, with cost estimates, payback periods, and tested product recommendations. Includes a printable household audit. Paperback, 224 pages, recycled paper.

name: Bedtime Stories Collection
description: 30 illustrated bedtime stories for children ages 3-8. Calming pacing, gentle endings, and stunning watercolor art on every spread.
full_description: A treasury of original stories written by children's authors and illustrated by a team of seven watercolor artists. Each story is calibrated for a 5-7 minute read aloud, with soothing rhythms designed to help kids unwind. The book includes a parent guide and discussion prompts. Hardcover, 192 pages, 9×11 inches.

name: Learn Python in 30 Days
description: Project-based introduction to Python for absolute beginners. 30 daily lessons of 45 minutes, each ending with a working mini-project. Code on GitHub.
full_description: Designed for self-paced learning, this book covers Python 3.12 essentials: data types, control flow, functions, OOP, file I/O, REST APIs, pandas, and matplotlib. Each lesson concludes with a small project (a CLI tool, a scraper, a data dashboard) so you finish the month with a portfolio. Code is on a public GitHub repo, kept up to date. Paperback, 384 pages.

name: Illustrated World Atlas
description: Large-format atlas with 200+ original illustrations and thematic maps on culture, food, biodiversity, and history. A reference book that doubles as a beautiful object.
full_description: Beyond geography, this atlas tells the cultural story of every continent. Topographic maps are paired with illustrations of food, music, languages, and traditions. Researched by a team of 12 cartographers and illustrators over five years. Hardcover, 384 pages, 11.8×15 inches, weight 2.4 kg.

name: Yoga for Beginners
description: A gentle introduction to yoga with 50 foundational poses, three sequenced classes, and clear photo demos. Includes a 4-week starter plan and breathing primer.
full_description: Written by a certified yoga teacher, this book teaches alignment first, intensity later. Each pose is shown from two angles with notes on what to avoid and how to modify for limited mobility or injuries. Three full classes (15, 30, 45 minutes) progress in difficulty. Includes a chapter on pranayama and a printable 4-week home practice schedule. Paperback, 200 pages.

name: Classic European Novels Vol. 1
description: A boxed set of five classic European novels in modern translations: Madame Bovary, The Stranger, The Master and Margarita, Buddenbrooks, and The Leopard.
full_description: Beautifully bound paperback editions in a sturdy slipcase, each with a fresh translation by award-winning translators and a new introduction by contemporary critics. Acid-free cream paper for comfortable reading. A gift-worthy box for fans of European literature or a stepping stone for new readers. 5 books, ~300 pages each.

name: The Spice Trade History
description: A 600-year history of the global spice trade, from medieval Venice to modern industrial supply chains. Engaging, surprising, and meticulously researched.
full_description: An ambitious narrative history that follows pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg, saffron, and chili across continents. Combines economic history, food culture, and biography of key traders, navigators, and farmers. Includes 16 pages of color plates and a detailed timeline. Paperback, 416 pages.

name: Watercolor Techniques Manual
description: Step-by-step watercolor manual covering wet-on-wet, glazing, masking, and 20 painting projects from landscape to botanical. Suitable for beginners through intermediate.
full_description: Built on three decades of teaching, this manual breaks down techniques in clear stages with annotated photographs. The 20 projects (a forest path, a citrus still life, a portrait, etc.) each take 60-90 minutes. Includes a materials guide, color theory primer, and troubleshooting chapter. Spiral-bound to lay flat while painting. 224 pages.

name: Garden Design Inspiration
description: 60 contemporary garden designs from around the world, photographed across the seasons. Plant lists, hardscape details, and lessons for any size of plot.
full_description: Curated by a landscape architect, this book features urban courtyards, country meadows, and Mediterranean terraces. Each garden is documented in spring, summer, and autumn, with annotated plans and a complete plant list. Practical takeaways at the end of every chapter help readers adapt the ideas to their own outdoor space. Hardcover, 288 pages.

name: Mystery Novels Boxset
description: Six bestselling mystery novels by acclaimed authors in a single boxset. Hours of suspense, twisty plots, and unforgettable detectives. Great gift for readers.
full_description: A curated collection of six standalone mysteries published over the past decade, all critically acclaimed and widely translated. The boxset is printed on cream paper for comfortable reading, with thematically designed covers that look beautiful on a shelf. 6 paperbacks, ~340 pages each.

name: Linen Summer Dress
description: Midi-length linen dress with relaxed silhouette, side pockets, and tortoise-shell button placket. Pure flax linen breathes beautifully in heat.
full_description: Cut from European-grown washed linen for an immediate soft handle, this dress has a forgiving A-line shape, three-quarter sleeves, and a notched collar. The deep side pockets are functional, the buttons are real horn. Colors: ecru, sage, rust. Sizes XS-XL. 100% linen, machine washable cold.

name: Cashmere V-Neck Sweater
description: Mid-weight cashmere V-neck sweater knitted in Scotland. Soft, durable, and cut for everyday layering — pairs equally with jeans or tailored trousers.
full_description: Made from grade-A Mongolian cashmere, knitted on traditional Hawick looms. The 12-gauge construction is light enough for transitional weather but warm enough for winter under a coat. Ribbed V-neck and cuffs, slim-but-not-skinny silhouette. Colors: charcoal, navy, oat, forest. Sizes XS-XXL.

name: Leather Crossbody Bag
description: Compact full-grain leather crossbody bag with adjustable strap, magnetic closure, and interior card slots. Holds a phone, wallet, and small essentials.
full_description: Vegetable-tanned full-grain leather sourced from Italian tanneries, hand-finished and hot-stamped with the maker's logo. Soft suede lining, antique brass hardware, and an adjustable strap that wears comfortably across the body or on the shoulder. Dimensions 22×15×6 cm. Colors: cognac, black, navy.

name: Silk Floral Scarf
description: Square silk twill scarf, hand-rolled edges, with an original floral print inspired by 19th-century botanical drawings. Versatile worn at the neck, in the hair, or on a bag.
full_description: 12-momme silk twill, digitally printed and steam-fixed for vibrant colors that don't fade in the first wash. Edges are hand-rolled and stitched by skilled artisans — a detail that distinguishes a quality scarf from a mass-market one. 90×90 cm, hand wash only or dry clean.

name: Tailored Wool Blazer
description: Single-breasted wool blazer with structured shoulder, peak lapel, and half-canvas construction. Dresses up jeans or anchors a suit — the most versatile piece in a wardrobe.
full_description: Cut from Italian Vitale Barberis Canonico wool, half-canvas construction with horsehair chest piece for a clean drape that improves with wear. Two functional flap pockets, working sleeve buttons, double back vent. Available in black, navy, and chocolate brown. Sizes 36-46.

name: Cotton Poplin Shirt
description: Crisp cotton poplin shirt with mother-of-pearl buttons, classic point collar, and a slightly tapered fit. The kind of shirt that goes with everything.
full_description: Made from 100s two-ply Egyptian cotton poplin, breathable and cool. Single-needle stitching at every seam for clean lines and durability. Mother-of-pearl buttons, French side seams, split yoke for shoulder mobility. White, sky blue, and pale pink. Sizes XS-XXL, made in Portugal.

name: High-Waist Denim Jeans
description: High-waist straight-leg jeans in 13-oz Japanese selvedge denim. Honest cut, sturdy fabric, and a fade pattern that becomes uniquely yours over time.
full_description: Sanforized 13-ounce selvedge denim woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama, Japan. The cut is high-waisted with a clean straight leg, no stretch. Five-pocket construction with copper rivets and a hidden flat-fell inseam. The denim will fade and develop a personal patina with wear. Sizes 24-34, 100% cotton.

name: Embroidered Espadrilles
description: Hand-embroidered cotton espadrilles with traditional jute soles. Lightweight, breathable, and the easiest summer slip-on you'll own.
full_description: Made by Spanish artisans following methods that haven't changed in a century. Cotton canvas uppers feature hand-embroidered floral motifs, a different colorway for each pair. The natural jute sole is wrapped and stitched by hand and finished with a thin layer of vulcanized rubber for longer wear. Sizes 36-42.

name: Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Freshwater pearl drop earrings on 14k gold-fill posts. Subtle, elegant, and right at home with both a t-shirt and a wedding outfit.
full_description: Hand-selected freshwater pearls (8-9 mm) with high luster and minimal blemishes, suspended from gold-fill posts and butterfly backs. Each pair is matched for size and shape. Comes in a small velvet pouch and gift box. Hypoallergenic, nickel-free.

name: Wide-Brim Straw Hat
description: Hand-woven raffia straw hat with a wide brim, grosgrain ribbon band, and packable construction. UPF 50+ sun protection without losing style.
full_description: Woven from raffia palm fibers in Madagascar, then steam-blocked into shape. The 11 cm brim provides excellent sun coverage; the ribbon band is removable for personalization. Packs flat for travel and reshapes easily. One size with internal drawstring (54-58 cm).

name: Wool Trench Coat
description: Mid-length wool trench coat with double-breasted closure, storm flap, and belted waist. Warm enough for autumn and winter — the wardrobe workhorse.
full_description: Heavy melton wool blend (80% wool, 20% nylon) lined with viscose for ease of layering. Classic trench details: storm flap, gun flap, D-ring belt, raglan sleeves with adjustable cuffs. Hits just below the knee. Available in camel, navy, and charcoal. Sizes XS-XL.

name: Pleated Midi Skirt
description: Pleated midi skirt in flowy satin, with elastic-back waistband and a gentle swing. Equally at home with sneakers or heeled boots.
full_description: Cut from a heavyweight satin that holds the pleats beautifully, the skirt has a partial elastic waistband for comfort and a smooth front for a clean line. Hem hits mid-calf, generous swing without being overwhelming. Colors: bottle green, blush, black, taupe. Sizes XS-XL.

name: Vintage Leather Belt
description: Hand-cut Italian leather belt with a brushed brass buckle. Develops a beautiful patina with use. Versatile width works with jeans, chinos, and trousers.
full_description: Single-piece full-grain bridle leather, hand-cut and edge-burnished by an Italian artisan in his small workshop in Tuscany. 3.5 cm width, brushed brass buckle, six holes. Built to last decades. Available in tan, dark brown, and black. Sizes 80-110 cm.

name: Cotton Knit Cardigan
description: Lightweight cotton cardigan with horn buttons, ribbed trim, and a relaxed fit. Perfect for layering through three seasons of the year.
full_description: Knitted from 100% organic cotton in a 7-gauge construction that's substantial without being warm — ideal for spring and autumn. Ribbed crew neck, cuffs, and hem keep the shape. Real horn buttons add character. Colors: ivory, sage, navy, terracotta. Sizes XS-XL.

name: Striped Cotton Tee
description: Classic Breton-stripe cotton t-shirt with boatneck collar and three-quarter sleeves. Heavyweight cotton, made to outlast trends.
full_description: 240g/m² combed cotton jersey, knitted and finished in Brittany, France — the home of the Breton stripe. The boatneck and three-quarter sleeves are faithful to the original 1858 design. Substantial, structured drape that doesn't go shapeless after a wash. Colors: navy/cream, black/cream, red/cream. Sizes XS-XXL.
